title: crm.product.prepare-sale-products, payload v1 (COMMAND)
description: Step 2 of the SALE saga (ADR-018 §5): create this sale's products as PNDG. Destination: crm.product.cmd.prepare-sale-products.v1. The consumer routes it into the SAME ProductService#create the synchronous endpoint calls, with saleOperationId = orderNumber — which is what makes a reissued command replay the first result instead of creating a second installation.

orderNumber.description: The sagaId, and the saleOperationId the consumer deduplicates on.

customerNumber.description: From account-service's own reply, never from the browser (ADR-015 §5.9).

serviceAddressId.description: AC-SALE-01-11: the address chosen for the main product. Ownership is validated by the consumer against customer-service, not asserted here.

campaignId.description: The PUBLIC campaign code (e.g. CMP-ADSL-01), never an internal id — the consumer resolves it through the catalog exactly as the synchronous path does.

items.description: The submitted basket, replayed from the saga's stored snapshot. Characteristic VALUES live here and nowhere else in order_db, which is why the snapshot exists at all (ADR-018 §4).

characteristics.description: characteristicId -> submitted value, forwarded verbatim. Validation belongs to product-service, which alone knows the declared data type (ADR-015 §6).
